info.title: KRONOS
info.description: Tools organized by caller and responsibility. All mutations are validated by the simulation engine and saved before broadcasting. Caller groups describe intended usage in one trusted local session; they are not authentication boundaries.

post.summary: Apply a natural-language intervention
post.description: Parse supported text and queue it for the next authoritative tick.

post.summary: Queue a player-directed action
post.description:
Buy, sell, transfer, price, produce, consume, communicate, build, upgrade, or move.

The player chooses actor_id; the engine still enforces ownership, funds, and stock.

post.summary: Spawn a citizen (setup or intervention)
post.description: Adds a citizen on a plot. Starting money enters the economy from outside.

post.summary: Process player prompt and execute determined toolkit endpoint
post.description:
Translates player natural language prompt via LLM into the best toolkit endpoint,
then executes it against the simulation.

get.description:
Own state, role, public bakery prices, neighbor names, and runnable action types.

Read-only; this is the same observation /decide sends to the AI provider.

post.summary: Validate an agent proposal without committing it
post.description:
Dry-run against a copied world. Saves no events, state, snapshots, or RNG changes.

Validation is only valid for the returned sequence; execution rechecks that version.

post.summary: Submit an agent action for engine execution
post.description:
Require actor_id to match citizen_id, then durably queue the proposal.

At the next tick a rule rejection records status "rejected" with an error code
and an action_rejected event. Stale versions still return 409.
Agents never mutate live state themselves; the full world arrives on WS /ws/world.

post.summary: Let the AI layer choose and submit this citizen's next action
post.description:
Observation → provider → the same path as POST /actions (logged even if rejected).

Returns 409 if the branch changed while the provider was thinking, and 422 if the provider
fails or times out.

post.summary: Ask a citizen a question, answered from its own event history
post.description: Read-only. Answers may only cite events in which this citizen took part.

patch.summary: Shift a citizen's goal weights by at most 10 points each
patch.description: Submitted as an adjust_goals action; weights are clamped and renormalised to 100.

post.summary: Gather from a shared natural stock into the citizen's employer
post.description:
Submitted as a gather_resource action at the citizen's current employer.

The employer must match the resource (wheat: farm). Takes up to quantity; a nearly empty
stock gives a partial gather, and an empty one is rejected as out_of_stock.

post.summary: Apply for a job at a business
post.description:
Submitted as an apply_job action. Requires being unemployed and a free slot.

The owner accepts (hire) or rejects (reject_application); unanswered applications are
resolved on the next tick: hired if a slot is free and the wage is covered, else rejected.

post.summary: Quit the current job
post.description: Submitted as a quit_job action; emits employment_changed.

post.summary: Found a business
post.description: Capital (at least 5,000 cents) moves from the founder into the new business's cash.

post.summary: Close a business (owner only)
post.description: Cash and goods return to the owner, employees are released, and the plot is freed.

post.summary: Accept a citizen's job application (owner only)
post.description: The citizen must have a pending application here (POST /api/agents/{id}/apply).

post.summary: Reject a citizen's job application (owner only)
Release an employee (owner only)
Buy goods from a business

get.description: Filter by a citizen on either side of the loan (lender or borrower) and by status.

post.summary: Offer a loan
post.description:
Creates an offer only; no money moves until the borrower accepts.

Owed = principal + principal * rate_bps // 10000 (flat per loan, integer cents).

post.summary: Accept or decline a loan offer (borrower only)
post.description: Accepting re-checks the lender's funds and moves the principal to the borrower.

post.summary: Repay part or all of a loan (borrower only)
post.description: Partial payments are allowed; the amount may not exceed what is still owed.

get.description: How this citizen feels about each citizen it knows, by trust (highest first).

schema.title: Response Agent Relationships Api Agents  Citizen Id  Relationships Get

get.summary: Read one tie in both directions
get.description:
a_to_b is a's trust, grudge and type toward b; b_to_a the reverse.

A direction without an entry is neutral (trust 0, acquaintance) with known false.

post.summary: Befriend, gift, ally, argue, insult, betray or mentor another citizen
post.description:
Submitted as an interact action; effects are fixed engine rules.

The target's feeling toward the actor changes (ally and argue change both directions).
gift moves amount cents to the target; ally needs the target's trust >= 50; insult costs
the target 2 reputation, betray costs the actor 10, mentor gives the target 2. One
interaction per pair per tick.

post.summary: Lease a vacant lot from its owner
post.description: actor_id becomes the tenant at the owner's current rent, collected every rent period.

patch.description: While leased, each change is limited to 20% of the current rent (at least 100 cents).

post.summary: Pay rent (tenant only)
post.description: Clears all arrears, or pays one period ahead when nothing is owed.

post.summary: Evict a tenant 3+ rent periods behind (owner only)
post.description: Arrears are written off and the tenant's business on the lot is closed.

get.description:
Average (integer cents, rounded half up), min, max, and seller count per good.

Defaults to the active branch.

Rebuilt from the branch's first checkpoint plus its saved price-affecting events.

One point at the branch start, then one per event that changed the average, min, max,
or seller count. Defaults to the active branch.

get.summary: Read a citizen's pending trade offers
get.description: Incoming offers are also part of the citizen's observation.

post.summary: Offer a trade to another citizen
post.description: The offerer (actor_id) must hold what it gives now; nothing moves until accepted.

post.summary: Accept or decline a trade offer (recipient only)
post.description: Accepting rechecks that both sides still hold their goods, then swaps them.

get.description: Sorted by kind. Stocks regenerate once per tick up to cap; farms and gatherers draw them.
Offers expire at the end of the tick they were made in.

schema.title: Response License Offers Api Inventions License Offers Get

post.summary: Research an invention with money or wage time
post.description:
Money mode spends `amount` (capped at what is left). Time mode forfeits the actor's wage
for `ticks` days, each counting as progress. At full cost the top contributor owns it.

post.summary: Offer a license (invention owner only)
post.description: Creates an offer; no money moves until the recipient accepts on the same tick.

post.summary: Accept or decline a license offer (recipient only)
post.description: Accepting re-checks funds and moves the fee from the recipient to the owner.

post.summary: Adopt an invention at a business (business owner with rights)
post.description:
Requires an unlocked invention, ownership or a license, and business cash for the
adoption cost. The production effect applies from the next production run.

get.description: Roles are derived: a citizen who owns a building is a business_owner.

schema.title: Response Role Matrix Api Roles Get

get.description: 0.5 * wealth share + 0.3 * reputation + 0.2 * trust from others, in basis points.

schema.title: Response Vote List Api Votes Get

post.summary: Propose a town vote
post.description: One open vote at a time, at most one new vote every 10 days; it closes after 3 days.

post.summary: Cast or change a ballot

get.description: The provider is the one actually configured (`KRONOS_LLM_PROVIDER`), not a constant.

post.summary: Advance the simulation by one day
Start the simulation clock
Pause the simulation clock
Queue a backend automation action
post.description:
Use the same version, engine, and persistence checks as other action callers.

This endpoint grants no extra capabilities. In-process jobs may call
Service.execute_action directly instead of making an HTTP request to this server.

post.summary: Create an independent village
post.description: Persist a new village; explicitly activate its branch to start using it.

get.description:
Businesses with a free slot, their wage, location, and pending applicants.

Apply with POST /api/agents/{id}/apply; the owner answers by hire or reject_application,
otherwise the next tick resolves the application automatically.

schema.title: Response Events Api History Events Get

get.description:
Events with sequence greater than `after`, oldest first, matching every filter.
Page by passing the last returned sequence as `after`.

parameters.name: target

schema.description: Citizen or entity named in the payload
schema.title: Target

parameters.description: Citizen or entity named in the payload

schema.title: Response Events After Api Events Get

get.description:
`back`: what caused this event (its causal_refs, recursively). `forward`: what it
caused (events citing it, recursively). Events from the same action are included.

schema.title: Response Snapshots Api History Snapshots Get

post.summary: Fork a saved checkpoint
post.description: Optional `intervention` text is parsed and queued on the fork's next day.

get.summary: Compare timelines' metrics day by day
get.description:
Per-branch series of bread price, wealth gap (Gini), population, total money and top
influence, including each fork's shared history before it split. Aligned by tick.

get.summary: Find where two timelines first decided differently
get.description:
After the shared history, the first decision (player or citizen action) that
differs, with each timeline's forward cause chain from it.

post.summary: Switch the active timeline

get.summary: World hash at the end of every day
get.description:
Determinism evidence: the same seed and the same actions give the same hashes, so
two timelines agree up to the first day their hashes differ.

schema.title: Response Branch Hashes Api Branches  Branch Id  Hashes Get

get.description: The last snapshot of each simulated year (`KRONOS_TICKS_PER_YEAR` days).

schema.title: Response Branch Checkpoints Api Branches  Branch Id  Checkpoints Get

post.summary: Run a timeline in the background
post.description:
Advance a non-active branch `ticks` days at full speed, off screen, while the live
branch keeps running. Citizens decide with the free utility policy (or not at all).

get.summary: Read events a citizen took part in
get.description:
Events where the citizen is the actor, sender, recipient, or subject; oldest first.

Defaults to the active branch.

schema.title: Response Citizen History Api Agents  Citizen Id  History Get

get.summary: Read the outcome of an agent action
get.description: Read an attempt in this API session; committed Events survive restarts.

post.summary: Speak a villager's line in their own voice (optional ElevenLabs)

Loan.title: Loan
Loan.description:
A loan between two citizens. Interest is flat per loan, in integer cents:
amount_owed = principal + principal * rate_bps // 10000, fixed when the offer is made.

Lifecycle: offered -> active (borrower accepts; principal moves lender -> borrower) or
declined. Offers still unanswered on due_tick become expired. An active loan not fully
repaid once tick > due_tick becomes defaulted (penalties apply once); a defaulted loan can
still be repaid and then becomes repaid.
